claude_proposed_widenings.name: class_feature_build_time_option_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Elemental Fury offers exactly one of two mechanically distinct options chosen at character build time. The existing `composite` family grants all parts simultaneously; no 'pick one of N' shape exists for ClassFeatureMechanics. This is distinct from CastTimeEffectModeChoice (cast-time) and from grant_feat (feat-level pick).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain one of the following options of your choice.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spell_filter on modify_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting narrows the damage bonus to 'any Druid cantrip'. The current modify_damage_numeric atom only has weaponFilter (weapon_category / weapon_property / specific_item). A parallel spellFilter (e.g. {kind: 'cantrip'} or {kind: 'class_cantrip', className: 'druid'}) is needed to scope the bonus correctly without lying about the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Druid cantrip.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Primal Strike fires once per turn when the druid hits with a weapon or Wild Shape attack, dealing bonus damage of a chosen type. This maps precisely to the on_hit_trigger / MasteryMechanics family, but that family is only available in MasteryMechanics / MagicItemComponentMechanics — not in ClassFeatureComponentMechanics. Extending ClassFeatureMechanics to admit on_hit_trigger (or a shared OnHitTriggerMechanics component) would unblock this and likely other class features (Divine Strike, Sneak Attack).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (choose when you hit).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: hit_time DamageType choice in on_hit_trigger context
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage type for Primal Strike is chosen at the moment of the hit from a closed set {cold, fire, lightning, thunder}. The DamageTypeRef.CastTimeChoice shape exists but its label 'cast_time' is semantically misleading for a hit-time choice. This may be representable with existing CastTimeChoice<DamageType> if the label is read loosely, or may need a parallel 'hit_time_choice' variant to be honest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (choose when you hit).
